chk_academic_audit_actor_invariant.name: chk_academic_audit_actor_invariant
chk_academic_audit_actor_invariant.value: ("actor_type" = 'USER' AND "actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("actor_type" = 'SYSTEM' AND "actor_user_id" IS NULL)

chk_attendance_arrival_time.name: chk_attendance_arrival_time
chk_attendance_arrival_time.value:
("status" = 'LATE' AND "arrival_time" IS NOT NULL AND ("arrival_time" GLOB '[0-1][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' OR "arrival_time" GLOB '2[0-3]:[0-5][0-9]'))
        OR ("status" = 'PRESENT' AND ("arrival_time" IS NULL OR "arrival_time" GLOB '[0-1][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' OR "arrival_time" GLOB '2[0-3]:[0-5][0-9]'))
        OR ("status" IN ('ABSENT', 'EXCUSED') AND "arrival_time" IS NULL)
